alex_support: Hey team — customer (acct_id: acct_9X2B) hit a barrage of 429s overnight during a scheduled embeddings reindex. They're on the Free tier and doing a one-off large job for a demo. Asking if we can grant a temporary quota uplift or a one-time exception so their demo doesn't fail.
maria_engineer: Can you paste a sample error/response and the timestamps? Need to check if this was strict global quota or a per-route rate-limit.
alex_support: Sure. Example from logs around 02:13 UTC:
```
2026-03-11T02:13:07Z ERROR request_id=rq_0f3b 429 Too Many Requests route=/v1/embeddings model=text-embed-3 size=2048
{"x-request-id":"rq_0f3b","status":429,"retry_after":60}
```
Looks like 429 with `retry_after` present. They also call embeddings in parallel from a k8s job (20 pods) which likely blew past burst limit.
maria_engineer: That sounds like quota exhaustion + per-minute burst cap. Free tier has low concurrent/burst allowance. Did they hit any auth/billing issues? Any invoice failure? alex_support: Billing is fine — account created recently and credits available, but plan limits apply. Customer requests either: a) temporary bump to free-tier burst for next 24 hours or b) fast-path to a paid trial with higher caps. They said it's urgent for a live demo at 14:00 PT.
jordan_ops: For temporary bumps we usually apply a short-lived exception (24h) for demo customers. Need approval from sales and a record in the escalation log. Sam, can you weigh in on a trial conversion or short-term commit?
sam_sales: We can offer a 14-day trial of the Paid tier with increased rate-limits pending standard conversion cadence. But we need the customer's email and confirm they accept billing terms. If they prefer a purely temporary exception without trial, ops can apply a 24h uplift but we should capture their use-case.
alex_support: Customer email is demo+acme@customer.com. They're not ready for paid yet — want a one-off job. Could we do a 24h uplift to allow 50 concurrent embedding requests and a higher per-minute token cap?
maria_engineer: Technically feasible. Ops steps:
1) Create an account-level exception flag `temp_burst=24h` with concurrency=50, rate_per_minute=30000.
2) Monitor for any runaway cost. Quota-bot will alert at 75% usage.
jordan_ops: I'll prepare the change. Need ticket recorded and customer's ack. Alex, can you confirm they accept we may throttle if abuse detected?
alex_support: Confirmed, customer acked in thread: "we accept throttling and will pause if you ask". They also provided request IDs for repro: `rq_0f3b`, `rq_0f4c`, `rq_0f6d`.
quota-bot: Alert rule: temp_burst acct_9X2B enabled. Thresholds: 75% -> notify @maria_engineer, 95% -> auto-throttle.
maria_engineer: I'll keep an eye on latency — if we see tail latency spikes, we may recommend staging the job as batches or using our Dedicated option for predictable throughput.
sam_sales: Looping in sales follow-up: sam_sales -> will send a trial invite and follow up with pricing options if they want reserved capacity. Also create a short handoff doc.
alex_support: Thanks. Jordan — can you paste the ops ticket ID when it's created? I'll update the customer.
jordan_ops: Ticket created: SUP-2026-1197. Applied `temp_burst=24h` at 2026-03-11T03:02:14Z. Monitoring enabled. Will update in 5m.
alex_support: Perfect, ping me when it's live and I'll confirm with customer. :thumbsup:
